mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.author_id, a.category_id, a.is_top, a.is_original, a.status, a.published_time, a.created_time, a.updated_time, u.nickname AS author_name, c.name AS category_name
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.content, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.author_id, a.category_id, a.is_top, a.is_original, a.status, a.published_time, a.created_time, a.updated_time, u.nickname AS author_name, c.name AS category_name FROM tl_article a LEFT JOIN tl_user u ON u.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN tl_category c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
